reuse.why: Extends the existing shared assertBankAccountNotLinked used by every provider, but the local unlink re-writes unlinkAccount's field reset instead of extracting and sharing it.

duplication.why: The db.updateAccount block nulling account_id/bank/balances/sync source/status is a verbatim copy of the one in unlinkAccount.

placement.why: The takeover is in the shared pre-link check, which reaches all providers, but a function named assert... now mutates other accounts as a side effect.

scope.why: Only flag plumbing through the six provider link handlers and the shared check.

maintainability.why: Readers of assertBankAccountNotLinked would not expect it to unlink accounts, and the copied reset can drift from unlinkAccount.

bypasses_abstraction.where: accounts/app.ts assertBankAccountNotLinked: own copy of the local-unlink db.updateAccount instead of a helper shared with unlinkAccount

disguised_duplication.where: the unlink field reset is a literal copy
